title: Divergence-test bound for translated directional derivatives
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, and let R, C ∈ ℝ. Assume ∫_F div g dL^N ≤ C for every C¹ vector field g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N that has compact support, satisfies tsupport g ⊆ B_{R+1}(0), and has |g(y)| ≤ 1 for all y. Here div g = trace Dg (euclideanDivergence) and ∫_F is integration against L^N⌞F. Let ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ be C¹ with compact support, tsupport ψ ⊆ B_R(0), and |ψ(y)| ≤ 1 for all y. Then |∫_F Dψ(z − a)[h] dz| ≤ C|h| for all a, h ∈ ℝ^N with |a| ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (R C : ℝ), (∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) (R + 1) → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g y ≤ C) → ∀ ψ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → (∀ y, |ψ y| ≤ 1) → ∀ a h : Rn N, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → |∫ z in F, fderiv ℝ ψ (z - a) h| ≤ C * ‖h‖
